label: Contracts: Restructure and Extension now check the real deadline, not just contract shape — a held veteran past the September contract deadline (e.g. a final-year player traded in mid-season) no longer shows as eligible for either, and a pre-season WW/FCFS pickup still at MYAC or MYM on Roster Workbench no longer shows extension-eligible under the wrong (in-season) clock. IR: the eligibility alert on Front Office only counts a real IR-type NFL designation (IR / suspended / holdout / COVID) — a plain game-day "Out" or "Doubtful" no longer inflates the count. Trade War Room: loaded contracts (front- or back-loaded, max 5 per roster) are now their own compliance check on both mobile and desktop — a trade that would push a team over the limit disables Accept and names the team and count, independent of the cap check. The lineup check is relabeled "structural lineup feasibility": it confirms enough players exist at each position, and now says plainly — in both the ok and heads-up states — that it does not account for this week's byes, injuries, Out/Doubtful designations, or kickoff locks. Both checks share the same server-computed card as the cap and roster rows already did.
